outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry dot plots (gating strategy for B cells and subsets); these are scatter plots where individual cells/events are already displayed as points, so no additional overlay of individual data points is needed.
Panel B shows flow cytometry dot plots (PC identification); individual events are already plotted as points, exempting it from the requirement.
Panel C shows flow cytometry scatter plots (MBC gating strategy) where individual cells are directly plotted as dots, not averaged summary data.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay of scatter plots (individual cells for MBC, GC, naive populations shown as colored dots), not an averaged summary statistic.
Panel E shows flow cytometry scatter plots (MBC subset gating) with individual events plotted as dots; no averaging is depicted.
